test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'anxieties'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a word that would describe the nervousness and uneasiness of the parents.
 
• For this purpose, the correct word is **anxieties.** 
 
• Anxieties mean** "a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome".**
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer. 

 

*Correct passage - **As the education of girls becomes similar (1) to that of boys, their home life will also become similar. Their present greater (2) knowledge of domestic affairs will also disappear. After a (3) certain age, boys and girls should have a share in parental occupations and (4) anxieties__, but not in excess as it would interfere with their education. Yet, (5) awareness of the problems of adult life helps boys and girls understand and appreciate the efforts of their parents.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The meanings of the other options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Reluctance - **unwillingness or disinclination to do something.
 
• **Hesitation - **the action of pausing before saying or doing something.
 
• **Mistrusts - **be suspicious of; have no confidence in.
